metadata.title: Schwarz lemmas and rigidity of \(\bar\partial_b\)-harmonic maps
metadata.abstract: We prove Schwarz lemmas for \(\bar\partial_b\)-harmonic maps from complete pseudo-Hermitian manifolds into K"ahler manifolds of negative curvature. For maps of bounded generalized dilatation we bound the full and the horizontal differential. For CR maps a coupled Bochner identity yields rank-dependent horizontal estimates and a bound for the Reeb differential. On Sasakian sources and complex hyperbolic targets we classify the maps attaining the horizontal bound, bound the deviation from equality in integral form by the deficit at one point, and prove compactness of almost extremal sequences. As an application, a Siu-type divergence identity yields foliation, pluriharmonicity and rank rigidity under volume growth conditions.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.progressType: 伪 Hermitian 调和映射的 Schwarz 刚性
analysis.workSummary: 对完备 pseudo-Hermitian 源到负曲率 Kähler 靶给 ∂̄b-harmonic 的微分估计；在 Sasakian/complex hyperbolic 情形刻画等号、deficit 及 almost-extremal 紧性，并用 Siu 型恒等式得秩刚性。
analysis.breakthrough: 把点态 Schwarz 界推进到等号分类和近等号控制。
analysis.limitations: 一般源估计、Sasakian 等号分类及体积增长下的 rigidity 使用不同假设。
